author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
The story concludes with my Survivor comleting the final five miles to safety. Will I starve, run out of Bullets or get killed by the Rotten and Crows? You'll have to watch to know. 

House Rules by the end...
- Roll for Defence on each Damage point you would take instead of once to block it all. 
- Resting heals 1 Health OR 1 Crave. 2 Rests will heal an Injury if done consecutively. 
- Draw another Mile card to replace any Face cards you reveal. 
- Make Defensive rolls for Rotten and Crows as well. 
- Allo combineable items to take up a single Equipment slot (Scope on Pistol for example, ammo already does this).

Check it out for yourself HERE: https://blacksitestudio.com/en-ca/products/last-mile-zine
